Provenance.description:
Where an artifact came from and what it was produced against.

Report 01 §B4 is the reason this exists and is required on every agent-produced
artifact: the summer's annotations asserted repository facts with no record of the
repository state they were written against, and those assertions went silently false.

context_package_id.description: ContextPackage this artifact was generated from.
context_package_id.title: Context Package Id

corpus_version.description: Corpus registry version this was generated against.
corpus_version.title: Corpus Version

input_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the exact input content (staleness check).
input_fingerprint.title: Input Fingerprint

model.description: Model id, or None if deterministic.
model.title: Model

producer.description: Component that produced the artifact, e.g. 'annotator'.
producer.title: Producer

provider.description: LLM provider, or None for deterministic producers.
provider.title: Provider
